{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Filter to completed orders
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
completed_orders_clean = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue from string to float (remove commas)
completed_orders_clean['revenue_float'] = completed_orders_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
